name: CBNU E10 video-referenced corridor

evidence.observation: Straight corridor, teal and white doors, green floor borders, round downlights, black skirting, red extinguishers.
Start stairwell: ascending flight on left, descending void on right, stone steps, green walls, metal rail.
Alcove on forward-right: plants, water dispenser and windows.
Far stair opening on left, elevator with wood trim and tactile tiles on right, end window with guardrail.
Directory sign visibly identifies E10 3F; no other-floor interior surveyed.

limitations: Only the four user-supplied dimensions are measurement constraints; the 0.16 m riser is approximate.
38.4 m length is an editable visual-layout estimate, not a surveyed or recovered video-odometry measurement.
13 risers are a visual count estimate; 0.28 m tread and terminal landings are inferred.
Far stairs and downward-flight completion reuse estimated start-flight dimensions; hidden geometry is not observed.
All six interiors repeat the surveyed third-floor layout at the user's request; floors other than 3 are not independent survey reconstructions.
Room-door count, spacing, signs and elevator dimensions are approximate; no unverified room names are reproduced.
Closed doors and elevator are static; no robot policy or door/elevator animation is included.
